detailed_description: The List Randomizer shuffles pasted line-based text in the browser. Paste one item per line, click Shuffle List, and the tool removes blank lines before returning the items in a randomized order. The result appears in a read-only textarea and can be copied to the clipboard. It uses a simple Fisher-Yates shuffle with Math.random; it does not support file upload, CSV or JSON parsing, seed values, delimiter controls, cryptographic randomness, reproducible shuffles, or downloads.
usage_steps: Paste the items you want to shuffle into the original list textarea, one item per line.
Click Shuffle List to randomize the non-empty lines.
Review the randomized list in the output textarea.
Use Copy Result to copy the shuffled list, or Clear to empty the original list.
usage_examples: Shuffle a short list of student names for a classroom activity.
Randomize a pasted checklist before assigning tasks.
Reorder survey questions that are already listed one per line.
Create a quick randomized list for a draft or note.
